name: Taverley Dungeon (upper level)
accessNote: Black dragons in this upper level can only be killed while on a Slayer task. Includes 12 adult dragons and 5 baby dragons; the baby black dragon task-only area can be AFKed quickly. Blue dragons here are task-only adults and require level 70 Agility for a shortcut or a dusty key.

travel.note: Falador teleport, then run west to the Taverley Dungeon.
